prompt:
Create a lightweight floating chaos portal rift for a Unity VR scene.
It should be an unstable moving portal made of broken floating stone fragments, jagged shards, and chaotic magical energy.
The center must stay open and empty for a portal effect.
No heavy base, no stairs, no platform, no candles.
The portal should look like it can move, teleport, and flicker through the scene.
Use an asymmetrical broken ring shape with purple, cyan, and green glow accents.
Stylized low-to-mid poly game-ready prop.
